archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: a release proof, not a loop step: the STATIC proof of CLEAN_RELEASE_V1 section 1 (no machine path written into a part's code)
question: Does this part of the Alarm folder still have a machine path written into its code?

commands.name: scan
commands.does: scans a part's files (its MANIFEST.tsv, or every file with --all) and prints each CODE, MARKED and KNOWN row and a verdict

args.name: part folder
args.meaning: the part, e.g. <INSTALL>/Agentic; the files its MANIFEST.tsv lists (repo_path)

args.name: --all
args.meaning: every file under the folder instead of the MANIFEST

args.name: --tsv
args.meaning: also write every row (file, line, path, kind) to this new file

commands.writes: nothing, or the --tsv file (refused if it exists)

refuses.when: CODE or CALLS_ARCHIVE rows found (listed): verdict NOT CLEAN
refused: no MANIFEST.tsv without --all, the --tsv file exists, a listed file missing, a MACHINE_PATHS_KNOWN.tsv row with an empty column or a line that is no number; no part folder (prints the usage)

dry_runs.prints: CODE 0, CALLS_ARCHIVE 0, KNOWN 0, MARKED 0, NAMES_ARCHIVE 0, ARCHIVE 0, TEXT 0 -> CLEAN

rules: reads files only; writes nothing but the --tsv file
takes no settings file: it reads the part folder named

outputs.where: the --tsv file: one row per machine path found
stdout: one line per CODE, CALLS_ARCHIVE, MARKED or NAMES_ARCHIVE row
stdout: one line per KNOWN row
stdout: one line per MACHINE_PATHS_KNOWN.tsv row that matches nothing

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
